activity.notes: Mithridates II was one of the greatest Arsacid rulers. Modern chronologies vary over his accession, with reconstructions around 124/123 BCE and 122 BCE, while his death is generally placed around 88/87 BCE. ATLAS follows the reviewed Olbrycht chronology at year granularity and records c.122–c.88 BCE, explicitly approximate rather than forcing false precision.

sources.title: Marek Jan Olbrycht, The Early Reign of Mithradates II the Great in Parthia, Anabasis 1 (2010)
sources.citation_text: Olbrycht identifies Mithradates II as one of the greatest Parthian kings and gives his reign as 122–88/87 BCE.
